metadata.description: Official MemMesh plugins for Claude Code and other agents

plugins.name: memmesh
plugins.description: MemMesh — a memory + calibrated-prediction + behavior-discovery engine for AI apps. Persistent hierarchical memory, a bi-temporal knowledge graph, and forward predictions with provenance and abstention. The engine decides what to save; your agent's own model does any extraction (zero engine-side LLM cost).
